jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.jd: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems. We are hiring an engineer to design and ship multi-agent systems for financial services clients. You will build agent workflows with LangGraph, including planning, tool calling and human approval steps. You will build retrieval pipelines (RAG) and measure their quality with automated evaluation. You will connect agents to real systems through tools and MCP servers with proper authentication. Experience fine-tuning large language models is required. You will mentor other engineers and set engineering standards. A record of peer-reviewed machine learning research publications is a plus.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.jd: AI Solution Architect. You will work with enterprise customers to scope, design and deliver AI solutions. Responsibilities: run discovery and requirements workshops with business stakeholders; design end-to-end architectures for LLM applications on AWS, including data, retrieval, evaluation and security; build proofs of concept and hand over to delivery teams; deploy infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD. Requirements: 5+ years building production software; hands-on experience with RAG and agent frameworks; experience deploying on-premise or air-gapped AI systems for regulated clients; strong written communication. Nice to have: experience with Kubernetes at scale and SAP integrations.

jobs.title: Full-stack AI Software Engineer
jobs.jd: Full-stack AI Software Engineer. Join a small product team building AI-native applications. You will build React and TypeScript front ends with streaming chat interfaces, and Python back ends with FastAPI. You will integrate LLM APIs, design prompts and structured outputs, and add guardrails against prompt injection. You will write automated tests and keep costs under control with usage limits. Requirements: strong TypeScript and Python; experience shipping LLM features to real users; experience with PostgreSQL or similar databases; comfortable owning features end to end. Bonus: mobile app experience and speech-to-text.

jobs.title: A role that is a poor fit
jobs.jd: Embedded Firmware Engineer. We build flight controllers for industrial drones. You will write hard real-time firmware in C and Rust for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers, design PCB bring-up tests, and tune PID control loops. Requirements: 5+ years of embedded C on bare metal or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr; experience with CAN bus, SPI and I2C drivers; oscilloscope and logic analyser debugging; DO-178C or similar safety certification experience. Nice to have: FPGA development in Verilog and RF antenna design.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Scientist
jobs.jd: Machine Learning Research Scientist. You will lead original research on large-scale pretraining of foundation models. Requirements: PhD in machine learning or a related field; first-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR; experience training models on thousands of GPUs; deep knowledge of optimisation theory and distributed training in JAX or PyTorch. You will also mentor junior researchers and collaborate with product engineers on fine-tuning and evaluation of language models for clinical text.
